description: React functional component called ExpenseForm for adding new expense entries in an expense tracker application. It manages form state, input validation, and submits expense data via a callback.

methods.name: ExpenseForm({ categories, onSubmit })
methods.description: Functional React component rendering a form to add a new expense, managing state for amount, category, notes, and date, and handling form submission.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission: validates inputs, calls onSubmit prop with expense data, and resets form fields.
